definition: Professional negligence in English law concerns a professional's failure to meet a legally required standard of care, causing actionable loss.
entry_text: Professional negligence in English law concerns a professional's failure to meet a legally required standard of care, causing actionable loss.
example: A court considers whether an adviser acted with the care reasonably expected of someone in that profession.
label: Professional negligence in English law
